description: Ground-truth manifest for substrate-docs: every identifier the docs may reference, extracted from a Substrate engine checkout. Regenerate with scripts/generate-manifest.ts; never hand-edit.

cssVariables.provenance: generated-css-glob (generated/**/*.css, src/platforms/web/styles/**/*.css): custom-property definitions and @property registrations
cssVariables.description: CSS custom properties the engine defines. Exact names cover shipped brands; patterns cover the open intent map (a brand may declare any intent, so its --ucs-{intent}-* family is pattern-shaped).

patterns.description: Solver-written intent primitives for any declared intent.

patterns.provenance: per-mode baked token files (SubstrateSystemTokenSet fields surface/text/border)
patterns.description: Baked per-mode intent triptych for any declared intent.
Per-text-role foreground lightness for any declared intent.

dataAttributes.provenance: generated/shipped CSS selectors + runtime attribute writes (src/platforms/web/runtime, src/platforms/web/css)
dataAttributes.description: HTML data attributes the engine reads (cascade opt-in, role selection) or writes (brand, CVD state).

cliCommands.provenance: CLI dispatch and usage banner (packages/cli/bin/main.js via the substrate-init.js shim, plus lib/setup-plan.js); npm scripts from engine package.json
cliCommands.description: The real CLI surface. There is no `substrate build`; generation runs through npm scripts in the engine checkout.

cliFlags.provenance: flag spellings in packages/cli/bin/main.js and lib/setup-plan.js
cliFlags.description: CLI flags, so `--flag` spellings in shell/inline code are not mistaken for CSS variables.

engineExports.provenance: Object.keys of the @substrate/engine barrel (src/index.ts), engine value import

nativeSymbols.provenance: declaration scan of generated Swift/Kotlin artifacts and the kernel-swift / kernel-kotlin packages
nativeSymbols.description: Type/object names a native example may reference, including the SubstrateKernel package name.

configKeys.provenance: shipped brand YAML configs (src/brands/**/config*.yaml), system.config.yaml, and merged BrandConfig objects from the engine brand loader
configKeys.description: Valid brand-config keys, both kebab-case as authored and camelCase as normalized. Children of open maps (intents, gradients, materials, ramps, presets levels, system) are brand-chosen names and are not enumerated.

presets.description: Named modes are presets over the continuous scheme/contrastFactor axes. dimmed sits mid-track at scheme 0.65 — lighter than dark.

preferences.description: The continuous preference vector and its engine defaults. Note motionFactor defaults to 0.75.

apcaPolicy.description: Fixed APCA targets, scaled at runtime by contrastFactor; transforms run warmth → cvd → apca.

scalarTokens.provenance: names verified against the generated-css glob; copy authored here and versioned with the generator
scalarTokens.description: The continuous scalar tokens — the whole dimensional system is these scalars composed with calc(), not enumerated ladders.

entries.name: --density
entries.description: Continuous density multiplier written by the runtime from densityFactor (0.8 → 1.3). Scales spacing, sizing, and border radius at use sites.

entries.name: --scale
entries.description: Continuous size multiplier composed into spatial calc() expressions alongside --density.

entries.name: --contrast-factor
entries.description: The user's continuous contrast preference (0.75 → 1.5). Scales every APCA Lc target.

entries.name: --motion-factor
entries.description: Continuous motion preference, 0 (instant/reduced) → 1 (full brand duration). Defaults to 0.75; set to 0 under prefers-reduced-motion.

entries.name: --type-scale-factor
entries.description: Continuous type-scale preference (0.9 → 1.4), folded into --effective-ratio.

entries.name: --duration-base
entries.description: The brand's base duration in ms, from motion.duration-base.

entries.name: --duration
entries.description: Resolved duration: calc(var(--duration-base) * var(--motion-factor)).

entries.name: --easing
entries.description: The brand's single authored easing string, from motion.easing.

entries.name: --radius-base
entries.description: The brand's base corner radius in px, from shape.radius-base.

entries.name: --radius
entries.description: Resolved radius: calc(var(--radius-base) * var(--density)).

entries.name: --space-unit
entries.description: The brand's spatial unit in px, from space.unit. The only --space-* token; spacing is computed, not enumerated.

entries.name: --scale-ratio
entries.description: The brand's modular type ratio, from typography.scale-ratio.

entries.name: --effective-ratio
entries.description: The ratio actually used for type sizing: calc(1 + (var(--scale-ratio) - 1) * var(--type-scale-factor)).

entries.name: --font-size-base
entries.description: Base font size in rem, from typography.base-font-size.

entries.name: --font-size-quantum
entries.description: Rounding quantum for computed font sizes (default 0.25rem).

entries.name: --font-size-rate
entries.description: Fluid typography rate, from typography.fluid.

entries.name: --weight-bump
entries.description: Font-weight increase that kicks in at high contrast factors.

entries.name: --font-heading
entries.description: Heading font stack, from typography.heading-family.

entries.name: --font-body
entries.description: Body font stack, from typography.body-family.

entries.name: --font-mono
entries.description: Monospace font stack, from typography.mono-family.

entries.name: --ucs-focus-ring
entries.description: The solved focus-ring color (target Lc 60 × contrastFactor).

entries.name: --ctx-surface-l
entries.description: The lightness of the actual surface the solver resolved against — the context every foreground was solved for.

intentPrimitives.provenance: INTENT_PRIMITIVE_SUFFIXES (src/kernel/system/config.ts), engine value import; copy authored here
intentPrimitives.description: Per-intent solver primitives: --ucs-{intent}-{suffix} for every intent the brand declares.

entries.description: OKLCH hue (0–360), constant from the brand config (or the scheme track at the current position).
OKLCH chroma (0–0.4), constant from the brand config (or the scheme track).
Solver-written foreground lightness — APCA Lc 75 (× contrastFactor) against the context surface.
Solver-written border lightness — APCA Lc 50 (× contrastFactor) against the context surface.
Solver-written accent surface lightness (deriveSurface).
CSS background-image pattern used in achromat mode so meaning never rides on color alone.

systemIntents.description: Conventional intent names. NOT a closed set: the brand's own intents map is the source of truth; only brand and neutral are required.
